Bengal: Man accused of shooting constable killed in police gunfight

A man accused of shooting a constable in West Bengal was killed in a gunfight with police. This incident marks the fifth death in what reports describe as police encounters since the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) came to power in the state. The encounters have occurred in various locations across Bengal, including Baruipur and Birbhum.
